chapter: Later ventures, lodges and San Francisco recollections
title: Johnny's girl bands
summary: Johnny's students formed girl bands and a couple of them later led their own dance orchestras.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: On that...when your brother was teaching, you mentioned he had...that he was teaching a lot of people here and that he had a couple of girl bands that he was instructing. Tell me about the girl bands.
Well, they could play pretty good. Some of them, after he quit teaching them, a couple of them formed their own orchestra, and they played for dances and things around here a long time.
Do you remember who the leaders of those bands were or who some of the musicians were?
No. No, I've forgot all about them.
